nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a number of inputs, let $C$ be a list of gates, each encoded as a (kind, references) pair, and let $a = (a_0, a_1, \dots)$ be a list of booleans. The evaluation of $C$ on $a$ is the list of values of all gates, in order, of the flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs obtained by decoding each pair of $C$, under the assignment that sends each input $i < n$ to $a_i$, or to false when $i$ is at least the length…
nodes.title: Evaluation of an encoded Boolean circuit

nodes.summary: An encoded gate of a flat Boolean circuit is a pair $(k, r)$ of a natural number $k$, the kind of the gate, and a list $r$ of natural numbers, its references.
nodes.title: Encoded circuit gates

nodes.summary: The Circuit Value Problem is the decision problem that accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding of such triples, to a triple $(n, C, a)$ of a natural number $n$, a list $C$ of encoded gates and a list $a$ of booleans such that the flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs obtained by decoding the gates of $C$ is well formed, $a$ has length $n$, and the evaluation of $C$ on…
nodes.title: The Circuit Value Problem

nodes.summary: The Circuit Value Problem is in P, and every decision problem in P is log-space many-one reducible to the Circuit Value Problem.
nodes.title: The Circuit Value Problem is P-complete

nodes.summary: A list $C$ of encoded gates, each a (kind, references) pair, is well formed as a circuit on $n$ inputs when the flat Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs obtained by decoding each pair of $C$ is well formed: every decoded gate references only strictly earlier gates.
nodes.title: Well-formed encoded circuits

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
